changes.evidence: In Captain America: The First Avenger the HYDRA agent introduces himself to Col. Phillips as 'Fred Clemson, State Department' and attends Project Rebirth as a State Department official, undercover, until he blows his cover by killing Erskine. Undercover service the record leaves out.

In Daredevil: Born Again S2 Saunders is still an AVTF officer (episode 2 he joins the AVTF raid on Josie's; episode 3 he is on the AVTF team guarding the Northern Star at Red Hook) while secretly helping Daredevil, and AVTF leader Connor Powell kills him in episode 6 for betraying the unit. Like an informant in a crew, he serves the AVTF until his death; the S2 'NYPD' stage ends his AVTF service early and should go.
